title: Just Ok
text: Just Ok. I thought it was metal, but it feels like plastic. Looks ok once it's up, you can't tell. But for the price which was actually fairly low, still could or should have been about 10.00 cheaper for the quality. Came with all installation hardware and was easy to mount to the wall. I would buy again for my rental home but not for my own house. Just ok...

product_metadata.title: Kenney Classic Square 3/4" Standard Decorative Window Curtain Rod, Black, 66-120"
features: Set includes 2 finials, 4 brackets, a 0.75-inch diameter rod and mounting hardware
Classic Square finial features a geometric shape with clean lines
Easily adjusts from 66-to-120-Inch to fit medium to large windows
Rods can be easily cleaned with a soft dry cloth
description: From Levolor, the window design authority, these 0.75-inch decorative rod sets are designed for a relaxed lifestyle, perfect for light to medium weight draperies, curtains, sheers, or valances. The 0.75-inch rod diameter can be used with most drapery rod pockets, or tab tops. For easier opening and closing, or to hang pleated draperies, use with Kenney Clip Rings available in coordinating finishes (sold separately). Set includes 2 finials, 4 brackets, a 0.75-inch diameter rod and mounting hardware. The Kenney Classic Square finial features a geometric shape with clean lines. Telescoping steel rods are sturdy and easily adjustable from 66-to-120-Inch to fit medium to large windows. Kenney offers additional set sizes, holdbacks and clip rings to complete your entire decorating project. Rods can be easily cleaned with a soft dry cloth. Since the early 1900's Kenney has been setting the standard in window fashions, design innovation, product quality and customer satisfaction. Kenney remains the most recognized name in custom window coverings today. Kenney continues to offer great blinds and shades solutions in a wide variety of vertical, aluminum and wood blinds; cellular and woven wood shades; and sheer vertical window treatments. Kenney has expanded its product offering to include beautiful decorative drapery hardware, distributed nationally through home centers and other retailers.
